unit.why: A quoted teaching that controversy against a tsaddik may stem from a previous incarnation. It cites R. Yonatan (Eybeschütz) and the Pnei Yehoshua's part in the dispute only as an allusion, without narrating events.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a series of quotations from the same book (שביל התורה / שביל אמונה) on controversy against tsaddikim that runs across adjacent divisions.
